title: ChatGPT 5.5 changed how I use OpenAI!
description:
Full step by step video on my channel.
This video shows how ChatGPT Codex 5.5 has significantly changed the way I use OpenClaw. Learn how to hook up your existing ChatGPT subscription via OAuth and how to use chatgpt with your AI agents.

I also demonstrate what I've built using my $20 ChatGPT Plus free subscription.
